headline: Lānaʻi project district zoning change heard by committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: Lānaʻi project district zoning change heard by committee.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Bills 24 and 25 about the Lānaʻi Project District 2.[[0:15:00]] The landowner asked the committee to back the Planning Department and Lānaʻi Planning Commission on the zoning change.[[0:17:51]] The landowner said the State Land Use Commission approved its district boundary amendment with six votes.[[0:18:10]] The landowner asked the Council to put a time limit on the reporting required by condition 8.[[0:24:10]] The Planning Department said it supports the zoning change and amendment.[[0:28:29]] One member of the public gave oral testimony.[[0:30:23]] The landowner said it will move and preserve two old structures, including the Richardson home.[[0:32:40]] The landowner said its traffic study does not require the bypass road.[[0:34:46]] Chair Lee voiced support for the project and the changes.[[0:48:02]] The landowner said building the bypass road now would affect at least 50 or 60 homes.[[0:51:56]] The landowner said the homes already built have no income limits.[[1:02:43]] The chair called a 10-minute recess, set to return at 11 a.m.[[1:03:39]]
meeting.next: A member said they will look to the chair for recommendations on a reasonable time limit for reporting.

moments.q: Question on moving the Richardson home
